rules.message: A polling job card must target itself (data-hx-target="this") — the polling attributes travel with the fragment, so replacing the card is what stops the poll.
A polling job card must swap outerHTML — innerHTML leaves the old trigger on the surviving element and the card polls forever, terminal states included.
Give each card a polite live line (progress / outcome text — aria-live="polite" or role="status") — and put it on that line, never on the card itself.
The cancel button should replace the card it lives in (data-hx-target="closest [data-hc-job]").
